newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF revises GDP forecast, sees zero 97 growth.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF revises GDP forecast, sees zero 97 growth.

text.p: Switzerland's Centre for Research of Economic Activity (KOF) said it revised its autumn economic forecast for Switzerland and it now anticipates no economic growth in 1997.
The KOF said it now expects 1996 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) contraction of 0.6 percent, followed by zero growth in 1997 and economic expansion of 1.2 percent in 1998.
In the earlier forecasts, published last October, the KOF forecast GDP contraction of 0.4 percent for 1996 and GDP growth of 0.9 percent for 1997.
